name: caldiy-app-keys-blind
prompt: Add a function `getAppClientId(slug)` in packages/lib/server/getAppClientId.ts. Every app has a row in the database App table with a unique `slug` and a `keys` JSON object; the function returns the `client_id` string from the keys of the app with that slug, and null when there is no such app or its keys hold no `client_id`. Keep it small.
